Is it really free?
Yes, every game on the site is free to play and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need an account or have to sign up for anything?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter, so you can open a game and play right away.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games are browser games that start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse, which is noted on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site allows family-friendly games only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their progress the same way, but clearing your browser data or using private mode will erase it.
A game will not load. What can I do?
I can't promise a fix for every case, but if it keeps failing, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is. A real person reads the email.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. Others are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 24 were sent in directly by independent developers. Games are never copied from other portals.
I made a game. Can I get it on the site?

Yes, you can submit it for free at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/, and it is not exclusive, so you can publish it elsewhere too. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
You can embed the site's own games, which have an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded this way.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
